::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes\
**Cook time:** 45 minutes

[Main]{.badge .badge-main}
:::

*Always a popular choice in our house.*

## Ingredients

- 1 package of spaghetti
- 3 chicken breasts
- 2 cups chicken broth
- ½ stick butter
- 1 buttermilk ranch packet
- ½ onion, diced
- 1 can Rotel tomatoes
- 1 can cream of chicken soup
- garlic salt
- black pepper
- 1 block cream cheese
- ⅓ block Velveeta® cheese

## Instructions

1. Add all ingredients to the crock pot, excluding the cream cheese and Velveeta®.
2. Cook on high for 3½ hours.
3. Add cream cheese and Velveeta®, then cook an additional 30 minutes.
4. Shred and stir.
5. Boil the spaghetti to desired tenderness, strain, and add to the mixture in the crock pot.
